text: function reconstructShapeDensitySPE reconstructs islets images spe object. use estimated parameters . computational reasons, subset 20 images per patient rest vignette. result simple feature collection. contains polygons (<GEOMETRY> column), structure identifier (structID) image identifier (image_name). Let’s add patient metadata object. Using standard operations data frames can inspect number structures found per patient.
